---
title: "Tidy Tuesday 27/04/26"
output: html_document
date: "2026-04-27"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(tinytable)

# Download TidyTuesday data
tuesdata <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load("2026-04-28")

# Find what datasets are present for this week
names(tuesdata)

# Rename datasets for easier access
agreements <- tuesdata$agreements
quantity_codes <- tuesdata$quantity_codes
tariff_agricultural <- tuesdata$tariff_agricultural
tariff_codes <- tuesdata$tariff_codes
```


```{r view-data}
# View the structure of each dataset
glimpse(agreements)
glimpse(quantity_codes)
glimpse(tariff_agricultural)
glimpse(tariff_codes)

head(agreements)
head(quantity_codes)
head(tariff_agricultural)
head(tariff_codes)

str(agreements)
str(quantity_codes)
str(tariff_agricultural)

# tariff_agricultural = main data
# agreements = explains agreement names
# tariff_codes = explains product codes
# quantity_codes = explains measurement unit codes
```


```{r editing}

tariff_agricultural |> 
  filter(agreement == "canada") |> 
  summarise(
    rows = n(),
    earliest_begin = min(begin_effective_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_begin = max(begin_effective_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    earliest_end = min(end_effective_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    latest_end = max(end_effective_date, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

canada_1999 <- tariff_agricultural |> 
  filter(
    agreement == "canada",
   begin_effective_date <= as.Date("1999-12-31"),
   end_effective_date >= as.Date("1999-01-01")
  )

glimpse(canada_1999)

canada_1999_joined <- canada_1999 |> 
  left_join(tariff_codes, by = "hts8")

canada_1999_joined |> 
  select(hts8, description, ad_val_rate, specific_rate) |> 
  arrange(desc(specific_rate)) |> 
  print(n = 109)

glimpse(canada_1999_joined)

canada_1999_joined |> 
  filter(specific_rate > 0) |> 
  select(hts8, description, ad_val_rate, specific_rate)

# Flag tariff type for all products, not just nonzero
canada_1999_categorized <- canada_1999_joined |> 
  mutate(
    tariff_status = case_when(
      specific_rate >= 10000             ~ "Prohibitive/sentinel rate",
      specific_rate > 0                  ~ "Nonzero specific rate",
      ad_val_rate > 0                    ~ "Ad valorem rate only",
      TRUE                               ~ "Zero tariff (duty-free)"
    ),
    product_group = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "juice|vegetable juice") ~ "Juices",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "sugar|syrup")           ~ "Sugar/syrups",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "beef|bovine")           ~ "Beef/bovine",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "fish|salmon|cod|herring|anchov|sturgeon|sole|mackerel") ~ "Fish/seafood",
      TRUE                                                           ~ "Other agricultural"
    )
  )
```

```{r plotting}
# Flag tariff type for all products
canada_1999_categorized <- canada_1999_joined |> 
  mutate(
    tariff_status = case_when(
      specific_rate >= 10000             ~ "Prohibitive/sentinel rate",
      specific_rate > 0                  ~ "Nonzero specific rate",
      ad_val_rate > 0                    ~ "Ad valorem rate only",
      TRUE                               ~ "Zero tariff (duty-free)"
    ),
    product_group = case_when(
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "juice|vegetable juice") ~ "Juices",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "sugar|syrup")           ~ "Sugar/syrups",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "beef|bovine")           ~ "Beef/bovine",
      str_detect(str_to_lower(description), "fish|salmon|cod|herring|anchov|sturgeon|sole|mackerel") ~ "Fish/seafood",
      TRUE                                                           ~ "Other agricultural"
    )
  )

# Plot: product group breakdown by tariff status
canada_1999_categorized |> 
  count(product_group, tariff_status) |> 
  mutate(product_group = fct_reorder(product_group, n, sum)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = product_group, fill = tariff_status)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Zero tariff (duty-free)"      = "#2E86AB",
      "Ad valorem rate only"         = "#E84855",
      "Nonzero specific rate"        = "#E07F51",
      "Prohibitive/sentinel rate"    = "#C1121F"
    ),
    name = "Tariff status"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Canada–US Agricultural Tariff Lines Active in 1999",
    subtitle = "Most products were duty-free under NAFTA; juices and sugars faced high specific rates",
    x = "Number of products",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: TidyTuesday 2026-04-28 | USDA Agricultural Tariff Data"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle      = element_text(color = "grey40", size = 10),
    plot.caption       = element_text(color = "grey60", size = 8),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank()
  )
```
